label: GPT-6.1 Sol
output:
To: Bethan Rees
Subject: Re: Nia's hen - Tenby final plan + money!!

Beth,

Just replying to you, not getting into it on the group email. I've just landed off a Lagos so bear with me if this is a bit scrambled.

Will you have another think about coming, even just for Saturday? You don't have to do Friday at the cottage or spend the whole weekend pretending nothing's happened. Get there for 6 on Saturday, come for the meal and kip in with me afterwards. I've got the twin room. Train from Cardiff Central is about two and a half hours ish, and I'll pick you up from Tenby station. We can go in together.

I know November was horrible. What started over that comment about Lowri's ex at her 40th ended up with you both saying things, and I'm not trying to referee it now. I do think she's probably sorry underneath it, but she's stubborn, and you're not exactly known for backing down either. You don't need to sort the whole thing out before you can be there for Nia.

I swapped my Orlando with Kerry from work to get this weekend off, lost a night stop I really wanted as well. Not saying that to make you feel bad, just that I really want us there together.

Nia rang me crying last week asking whether you were still coming. She doesn't know you've pulled out yet. You're the one who sat with her in the Heath every night when her mam was bad in 2019. That's not a friendship I'd want this row getting in the middle of.

You'll be there doing your reading at Margam on 17th April, but I think you'd be sorry to have missed this bit with her. She'll miss you too — sending something lovely won't quite be the same as having you there.

Anyway, don't send Lowri any money yet. Have a sleep on it and let me know about Saturday. Train, lift, bed — we can make it easy.

Siân xx
